## Why clean documents were flagged for review

- LOW_CONFIDENCE:supplier_name: 7
- SUBTOTAL_MISMATCH:subtotal: 2
- TOTAL_MISMATCH:total: 2

Flagged clean files: digital_13_B.pdf, digital_21_B.pdf, scan_02_A.tiff, scan_06_A.tiff, scan_08_A.png, scan_09_D.jpg, multi_invoice.pdf

Expected flags NOT raised: none

## Misses (first 40)

- `scan_03_D.pdf` - supplier_name: expected 'Garcia LLC' got 'Seiler: Garcia LLC'
- `scan_06_A.tiff` - subtotal: expected 2925.75 got 75.0
- `scan_09_D.jpg` - subtotal: expected 4703.05 got 3.05

## Limitations

- The dataset is synthetic with known ground truth; real-world layouts will be harder. Re-run on labeled real documents with the same script (`manifest.json` format) before trusting these numbers in production.
- Scores for the rule-based baseline are *not* LLM scores. Set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and re-run to measure the LLM path.
- Timings are from a single machine with SQLite; PostgreSQL + multiple worker containers will differ.
